issue_context.title: BUG: PandasArray.to_numpy mishandles na_value
issue_context.body:
Problem is here:
https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/acacff35b1fe87875e2fddccbbadbc1c6834d156/pandas/core/arrays/numpy_.py#L358-L364

Since `na_value` is handled after the dtype conversion, calls like 
```
arr = pd.array([pd.NA, 1], dtype="string")
arr.to_numpy(na_value=True, dtype=bool)
```
fail.

review_comments: Why bfill? Also, this line won't have any effect anyway because `inplace=False` by default.
And `na_value` is no longer being used to fill
No reason for another temporary array, can just use result
